measurementRules.rule: Q0,c is independently weighed complete net powder at each unique first acceptance under cp_powder_qa_release, with raw tare and recorded conditioning; summed original events stay locked through all later fates. The first_powder_release row is exactly1kg, not Al/Zn content, nominal feed, bag mass or dry-matter assumption.

Convert actual measured raw units once: kWh×3.6=MJ electrical convention; actual volume requires independently measured same-solution density and temperature, actual gas amount requires actual state and composition, count requires measured same-configuration whole article mass. Do not infer powdermass from source flowrate×time, crystallite density, geometry or packaging count.

Whole conditioned powder mass includes actual retained constituents/moisture once. Report any separately determined drymass or composition on its own actual method/basis bridge. Analytical fraction, water, Al/Zn molar ratio and oxide mass ratio are not additive product purchases or interchangeable denominators.

Full V/Qt recorded once remains physical; V/Qt divided by a disclosed positive Q_analysis is observation only. Linked model uses distinct compatible-unit A_i,c/originalpositiveQ0,c once; no full shared treatment recharge, second division, serviceH divisor or allocated physical shrink.

calculationRules.rule: Preserve actual raw units and convert once using measured compatible unit/state bridges. kWh×3.6=MJ; gas/solution volume uses actual state/composition/density; a cumulative quantity is not multiplied by time again. Native electricity Net calorific value is retained without a fuel premise.

Calculate the actual analyte amount from blank-corrected concentration, actual final volume and all actual dilution/recovery factors under the applicable full method, divided by actual sampled whole mass when reporting mass fraction. Derive molar Al/(Al+Zn) only from actual elemental amounts with documented molar conversion values; do not map feedat% or oxidewt%. EPA300NO3/NO2 asN is not totalN.

Maintain disjoint complete raw, WIP, genuinely unused non-WIP, unreleased powder, accepted FG, test-specimen, equipment and packaging stocks in actual wet physical quantities. Maintain separately every inherited foreground exchange vector in its original native unit. Own opening foreground/WIP history is not a second purchase; a complete provider aggregate and its decomposed embedded upstream inventory are alternatives, not additive. A_i,c=B_open_i,c+U_new_i,c-B_close_unused_i,c-T_other_i,c only when U_new is before stock correction and the subtracted vectors are genuinely unused/unassigned. Accepted FG and already performed service are not unused Bclose. Use already-net consumption only with its documented equivalent bridge and no repeated correction. Keep assigned/unassigned vectors conserved.

x_i,c=A_i,c/originalpositiveQ0,c once for qualified compatible modeled demand. Full physical V/Qt divided by positiveQ_analysis is a labelled observation, not an extra model demand. Internal physical handoffs use actual traced material quantity/originalQ0,c once and paired cancellation, no procurement. Zero/unknown basis retains raw/unresolved; H is not divisor; first_powder_release is exactly1kg.

For every actual material gate in complete wet units: S_open+R_external+R_internal+J_in+H2O_in+OTHER_IN-X_OTHER_IN=S_close+T_external+T_internal+J_out+H2O_out+OTHER_OUT-X_OTHER_OUT. R/T are whole measured transfers, S are whole physical stocks, J are real mutually exclusive extra nonwater increments and H2O are real extra water crossings not already inside whole transfers/stocks. X removes only a proven identical child crossing duplicated in OTHER on the same side; it cannot cancel true J/water, full wet closing stocks, an opposite-side term or an unknown residual. Elemental and molecular ledgers are separate. The reference Q0 event account is not an additional physical output. Match internal powder handoffs by actual lot/state/quantity; cancel identical paired interfaces only on consolidation.

measurementRules.rule: Q0,c按cp_powder_qa_release在每个唯一首验门独立称完整粉体净量，具原皮重调湿记录；原事件和经所有后续去向保持固定。first_powder_release恰为1kg，不是Al/Zn含量标称进料袋重或假设干物质。
真实原始单位仅换算一次：kWh×3.6=MJ为电量约定；体积须独立实测同溶液密度温度，气量须真实状态组成，件数须实测同配置整件质量。不由来源流量乘时间、晶粒密度几何或包装件数推粉质量。
完整调湿粉重含真实留存成分水一次。另测干质量组成须有各自真实方法基准桥。分析分数水Al/Zn摩尔比及氧化物质量比非可加产品采购或可互换分母。
完整V/Qt一次记录保持实物；除声明正Q_analysis仅观察。模型用独立相容A_i,c除原正Q0,c一次，不全共享治理重收、不二除、不以服务H作分母或分配缩实物。

calculationRules.rule: 保留真实原单位并以实测相容单位状态桥仅换算一次。kWh×3.6=MJ，气液体积用真实状态组成密度；累计量不再乘时间。原生电力净热值保留且不假设燃料。
按适用完整方法，用空白校正浓度、真实终体积及全部实际稀释回收因子求分析物量；报质量分数再除真实取样整质量。仅由实际元素量及有据摩尔换算值求Al/(Al+Zn)，不映射进料at%或氧化物wt%。EPA300硝酸根亚硝酸根以N计不是总N。

按实际湿实物量保留互斥完整原料、在制、真实未用非在制、未放行粉、已验收成品、试样、设备及包装库存；另按每项原生单位保留全部自身继承前景交换向量。自身期初前景/在制史不是二次采购；完整provider聚合与其内含上游拆解为替代，不能相加。A_i,c=B_open_i,c+U_new_i,c-B_close_unused_i,c-T_other_i,c仅在U_new为库存修正前新增、被减向量真未用未归属时成立。已验收成品及已执行服务不是未用Bclose。已净消耗仅用有据等价桥且不重复库存修正。归属及未归属向量守恒。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 采集真实校准原始整量、供方接收方及匹配阶段记录。采用完整来源特定程序范围，保留全部失败空白库存调湿观察、不确定性、独立实物历史服务向量及整provider单位。不假设数值或修复核心冲突；真实首次验收仅在powder_qa，内部交接不新建。 每个实际具体袋、试剂瓶、瓶盖、运输箱及周转桶池按全湿量：O+P+I+ER+J_in+H2O_in+OTHER_IN-X_OTHER_IN=C+S+EO+W+J_out+H2O_out+OTHER_OUT-X_OTHER_OUT。P为互斥单独新购，I为随真实供货内容物进入包装，ER为客户周转池空件返厂输入，S含全部真实带内容物外发及真实退料带件仅一次，EO为单列空件向外返还，W为完整污染实际废物，O/C含全部空件、附原料在制成品及重复用库存。材料构造须确认，不能仅据供方bag/drum字样指定。内部复用装附仅内部抵消，不自动新购或credit。J水为未含整量的真实互斥额外增减，X仅去OTHER同侧重复，绝不冲真实增量或完整湿C。包装排除于粉体参考Q0。
